scripts.postinstall: test -d ui && npm --prefix ui install || true
scripts.rebuild: docker compose down --volumes && docker compose up -d --force-recreate --build
scripts.test:chatgpt: start-server-and-test 'npm run llm-mock -- --model=chatgpt' tcp:8001 'cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/gpt-mock-spec.cy.ts'
scripts.test:gemini: start-server-and-test 'npm run llm-mock -- --model=gemini' tcp:8001 'cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/gemini-mock-spec.cy.ts'
scripts.test:streaming: start-server-and-test 'npm run llm-mock -- --model=streaming' tcp:8001 'cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/streaming-only-spec.cy.ts'
scripts.test:embeddings: start-server-and-test 'npm run llm-mock -- --model=embeddings' tcp:8001 'cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/embeddings-spec.cy.ts'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile-ui && npm run test:chatgpt && npm run test:gemini && npm run test:streaming && npm run test:embeddings
